description: Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has launched MahaINDUS, a secure in-country AI platform for drafting, translation and tender evaluation in 22 Indian languages, along with 36 new schemes on MahaDBT 2.0, 71 services on Aaple Sarkar 2.0 and 13 services on the MAITRI portal.
body_lead: Maharashtra has added an artificial intelligence layer to the way its government machinery works. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on 28 October launched MahaINDUS, a secure AI platform built for administrative work, alongside a fresh set of citizen services on the state’s MahaDBT 2.0, Aaple Sarkar 2.0 and MAITRI portals. The launches came during a review meeting of the MahaSarthi portal at Sahyadri Guest House in Mumbai.
